p.src: 1  Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.

ja: らぐことなく、とこしえにとどまる。
en: Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
u.src: 1  Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.

p.src: 2  As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.

en: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.

p.src: 4  Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.
